name: Silhouette Splatting
definition: A method where cell vertices on the convex hull are connected to form a polygon, the centroid is found, and triangles are formed by connecting the centroid to the convex hull vertices. This is similar to splatting but operates on cells rather than sample points.
summary: Silhouette Splatting is a volume rendering technique that projects irregular grid cells as triangulated geometric primitives, differing from standard splatting by operating on cells rather than point samples.
